# `Q-2-58` — Quarto 1 diagram cell is not run

> Quarto 2 does not run `{mermaid}` or `{dot}` cells. The block renders as
> a code block, not a diagram.

## What this means

Quarto 1 draws diagrams from executable cells, written with braces:
```` ```{mermaid} ```` and ```` ```{dot} ````. Quarto 2 draws Mermaid
diagrams from the plain fence ```` ```mermaid ````, and has no Graphviz
support yet. A brace-form cell is left as a code block, so the reader sees
the diagram's source instead of the diagram.

## How to fix

**For Mermaid**, drop the braces. The diagram body and its `%%|` options
need no other change:

`````markdown
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Draft] --> B[Review]
```
`````

**For Graphviz (`{dot}`)**, there is no replacement yet. Pre-render the
diagram to an image and include it, or write the diagram in Mermaid.

**If an engine handles the brace form**, this warning does not apply to
the cells it claims. If you still see it, or want it gone, turn it off in
`_quarto.yml` or the document's front matter:

```yaml
diagnostics:
  Q-2-58:
    level: off
    reason: "our engine renders {dot} cells"
```

## Example

Bad input (Quarto 1 idiom):

`````markdown
```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Draft] --> B[Review]
```
`````

Corrected:

`````markdown
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Draft] --> B[Review]
```
`````
